note.en: 141 cards with every level and both language tables.
note.zh: 141 张卡牌，含全部等级与中英文文案。

note.en: 184 echoes and 270 affixes; 19 player echoes are indexed.
note.zh: 184 个回响、270 条词条；站内索引 19 个玩家回响。

note.en: 1,847 bilingual questions across the two banks.
note.zh: 两个题库共 1,847 道双语题。

note.en: 40 weekly periods across the four brackets, rebuilt from the archive snapshots.
note.zh: 40 个周期、四档数据，由归档快照重新聚合。

summary.en: Two new indexable pages explain where every number comes from and record each data and site release.
summary.zh: 新增两个可预渲染页面，说明数据来源与口径，并记录每次数据与站点更新。

summary.en: The build now verifies every prerendered page, canonical and sitemap URL before the gate passes; the route contract lives in scripts/verify-prerender.mjs.
summary.zh: 构建后会校验每个静态页、canonical 与 sitemap URL；路由契约写在 scripts/verify-prerender.mjs。

summary.en: Echo images walk WebP, PNG, the same-origin proxy, a local avatar and finally an initial placeholder without shifting layout.
summary.zh: 回响图片按 WebP → PNG → 同源代理 → 本地头像 → 首字母占位依次降级，失败也不抖动布局。

summary.en: Sales Optimizer inputs and selling strategy are kept in the URL, so a setup can be bookmarked or shared.
summary.zh: 销售优化器的输入与出售策略写入 URL，可收藏或分享配置。

summary.en: Quiz tab, filters, permalinks and challenge setup now live in the URL.
summary.zh: 测验的页签、筛选、固定链接与挑战配置都同步到 URL。

summary.en: Cards, echoes and every index page got their own indexable URL, per-page metadata and a generated sitemap.
summary.zh: 卡牌、回响与各索引页都有了独立 URL、逐页元数据与自动生成的 sitemap。

summary.en: One zh/en switch in the header drives the whole site, and the choice is remembered across visits.
summary.zh: 顶栏一个中英切换控制全站语言，选择会跨访问保留。
